settings.dateFormat: ISO, set at :246 before the report runs

book: create-ifrs-cost-basis-test-data (:54-243): accounts in CAD except USD Cash, USD CapGain, USD Interest, USD Commissions and Opening Balances USD; SPY is NYSE::SPY with SCU 10000. The fifteen SPY transactions (2019-07-01 to 2020-06-21) are in CAD, each split with the action the test gives it ("Buy", "Sell", "Fee" or ""; the Return of Capital's USD Cash split has none). Each split into a USD account adds a price of USD in CAD (1, or 20/17 for the 2020-05-10 conversion) and each SPY split with a non-zero amount a price of SPY in CAD; the price database keeps one per commodity, currency and day, so 2020-06-10's two transactions leave one SPY price (140) and one USD price. The report reads none of them: its rate converts the stock account's currency (Broker's CAD, gnc_account_get_currency_or_parent) to CAD. The two transactions of 2020-06-10 are ordered by entered date, creation order ("Sell SPY" before "Sell SPY Short").
dates: No date in the book or the run depends on now: Start Date and End Date are absolute (:256-259).
optionValues: Options are those the test sets (:251-259). {"absolute": day} is gnc-dmy2time64 of that day, local (here UTC) midnight. Accounts are full names. Stock Account, Dividend Account and Cap Gains Account keep their defaults, the first account of their types in display order (5.17:libgnucash/engine/gnc-option-impl.cpp:491-521): Root.Asset.Broker.SPY for Stock Account and Root.Income, the parent, for both Dividend Account and Cap Gains Account; so no split matches a dividend or capital gains account, USD CapGain being neither.
cellSelection: GnuCash reads text at HTML table positions with sxml->table-row-col (5.17:gnucash/report/test/test-report-extras.scm:96-109): table 1, row N (the Nth data row, the column headers being <th>), every <td> cell, giving every text node in document order. A figure that is none renders as an empty cell and gives no text, so the expected lists are shorter than the 28 columns and do not say which column each string is in. The columns, in order (5.17:gnucash/report/reports/standard/ifrs-cost-basis.scm:369-379): date, description, trans-units, cumul-units, note, curr, fx, purchase-val, purchase-cost, cash-dividends, proceeds-val, proceeds-cost, conv-purchase-val, conv-purchase-cost, conv-dividends, conv-proceeds-val, conv-proceeds-cost, cumulative-average-cost-basis, average-cost-basis/unit-for-sale, average-cost-basis-of-sale, net-proceeds, gain-post-commission, gain-pre-commission (calc), gain-pre-commission (register), gain-pre-commission variance, cumul-gross-profit, cumul-net-profit, cumul-tot-return.
